items.name: Anthropic (ANT)

note.de: 825 Mio. Aktien zu 70–78 USD plus Privatplatzierung über 26 Mrd. USD; laut Investing.com (16.11.) Preisfestsetzung am Mittwoch, 18.11., Handelsstart am Donnerstag, 19.11. Laut Bloomberg-Bericht (via Gulf News, 16.11.) fast siebenfach überzeichnet, ein Preis über der Spanne wird erwogen – unbestätigt.
note.bg: 825 млн. акции по 70–78 USD плюс частно пласиране за 26 млрд. USD; според Investing.com (16.11.) цената се определя в сряда, 18.11., а търговията започва в четвъртък, 19.11. Според Bloomberg (чрез Gulf News, 16.11.) поръчките са почти седем пъти повече от предлаганите акции и се обмисля цена над диапазона – непотвърдено.
note.en: 825m shares at USD 70–78 plus a USD 26bn private placement; according to Investing.com (16 Nov) pricing is due on Wednesday 18 Nov and trading on Thursday 19 Nov. A Bloomberg report (via Gulf News, 16 Nov) says the book is almost seven times covered and a price above the range is being considered – unconfirmed.
note.es: 825 millones de acciones a 70–78 USD más una colocación privada de 26.000 millones de USD; según Investing.com (16/11), el precio se fijará el miércoles 18/11 y cotizará desde el jueves 19/11. Según Bloomberg (vía Gulf News, 16/11), la demanda es casi siete veces la oferta y se estudia un precio por encima del rango – sin confirmar.
note.tr: 70–78 USD'den 825 milyon hisse ve 26 milyar USD'lik özel yerleşim; Investing.com'a göre (16.11) fiyat 18.11 Çarşamba belirlenecek, işlemler 19.11 Perşembe başlayacak. Bloomberg'e göre (Gulf News aracılığıyla, 16.11) talep arzın yaklaşık yedi katı ve aralığın üzerinde bir fiyat değerlendiriliyor – doğrulanmadı.

items.name: Japan Home Shield (667A)

sector.bg: Геотехнически проучвания и проверка на сгради
sector.es: Estudios geotécnicos e inspección de edificios

note.de: Börsenzulassung erteilt; reiner Verkauf von 4,17 Mio. Altaktien (plus Mehrzuteilung) zu vorläufig 1.220–1.240 JPY, Zeichnungsfrist 12.–17.11., Konsortialführer Nomura.
note.bg: Листването е одобрено; продават се само 4,17 млн. съществуващи акции (плюс допълнително разпределение) при ориентировъчна цена 1220–1240 JPY, записване 12–17.11., водеща банка Nomura.
note.en: Listing approved; secondary sale only of 4.17m existing shares (plus over-allotment) at an indicative JPY 1,220–1,240, book-building 12–17 Nov, lead manager Nomura.
note.es: Cotización aprobada; solo venta de 4,17 millones de acciones existentes (más sobreasignación) a 1.220–1.240 JPY indicativos, colocación del 12 al 17/11, coordinador Nomura.
note.tr: Kotasyon onaylandı; yalnızca 4,17 milyon mevcut hissenin satışı (artı ek tahsis), gösterge fiyat 1.220–1.240 JPY, talep toplama 12–17.11, lider aracı Nomura.

items.name: METKA (Metlen)

note.de: Rund 250 Mio. Euro aus neuen Aktien plus Verkauf von Altaktien durch Metlen; laut Fortune Greece Angebot in den letzten Novembertagen bei rund 1 Mrd. Euro Bewertung, Preisspanne offen.
note.bg: Около 250 млн. евро от нови акции плюс продажба на съществуващи от Metlen; според Fortune Greece предлагането е в последните дни на ноември при оценка около 1 млрд. евро, ценовият диапазон не е обявен.
note.en: About EUR 250m from new shares plus a sale of existing shares by Metlen; Fortune Greece expects the offer in late November at a valuation of about EUR 1bn, price range not yet set.
note.es: Unos 250 millones de euros en acciones nuevas más venta de acciones existentes por Metlen; según Fortune Greece, oferta a finales de noviembre con una valoración de 1.000 millones, sin rango de precios.
note.tr: Yeni hisselerden yaklaşık 250 milyon euro ve Metlen'in mevcut hisse satışı; Fortune Greece'e göre teklif kasım sonunda yaklaşık 1 milyar euro değerlemeyle, fiyat aralığı henüz belli değil.

items.name: American Barrick Gold (ABGC)

note.de: Abspaltung der Nordamerika-Minen von Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); Börsenprospekt am 10.11. eingereicht, Preis und Aktienzahl offen, Renaissance Capital schätzt bis zu 6 Mrd. USD; Start laut Barrick bis Anfang 2027.
note.bg: Отделяне на северноамериканските мини на Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); проспектът е подаден на 10.11., цена и брой акции още няма, Renaissance Capital оценява до 6 млрд. USD; старт според Barrick до началото на 2027 г.
note.en: Carve-out of Barrick Mining's North American mines (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); filed on 10 Nov with price and share count still open, Renaissance Capital estimates up to USD 6bn; launch by early 2027 according to Barrick.
note.es: Escisión de las minas norteamericanas de Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); folleto presentado el 10/11, sin precio ni número de acciones, Renaissance Capital estima hasta 6.000 millones de USD; lanzamiento a principios de 2027 según Barrick.
note.tr: Barrick Mining'in Kuzey Amerika madenlerinin ayrılması (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); izahname 10.11'de sunuldu, fiyat ve hisse sayısı belli değil, Renaissance Capital 6 milyar USD'ye kadar tahmin ediyor; Barrick'e göre başlangıç 2027 başına kadar.

items.src_n: Renaissance Capital – American Barrick Gold files for an estimated $6 billion IPO (10.11.2026); The Deep Dive (11.11.2026: Start bis Anfang 2027 laut CEO Mark Hill)

items.name: Windward Bio (WWB)

sector.es: Biotecnología (enfermedades respiratorias y de la piel)

note.de: Ausgabepreis 17 USD, die Mitte der Spanne von 16–18 USD; laut Renaissance Capital schloss die Aktie den ersten Handelstag 67,6 % über dem Ausgabepreis.
note.bg: Цена при предлагането 17 USD – средата на диапазона 16–18 USD; според Renaissance Capital акцията завърши първия ден с 67,6% над цената на предлагането.
note.en: Priced at USD 17, the midpoint of the USD 16–18 range; according to Renaissance Capital the stock ended its first day 67.6% above the offer price.
note.es: Precio de salida de 17 USD, el punto medio del rango de 16–18 USD; según Renaissance Capital, cerró su primer día un 67,6 % por encima del precio de salida.
note.tr: Halka arz fiyatı 16–18 USD aralığının ortası olan 17 USD; Renaissance Capital'e göre hisse ilk günü halka arz fiyatının %67,6 üzerinde kapattı.

items.src_n: Renaissance Capital – US IPO Weekly Recap (13.11.2026); Reuters – Windward Bio valued at $1 billion as shares rise in Nasdaq debut (13.11.2026, via 102.7 WBOW)

items.name: Adaspace (6935)

note.de: Ausgabepreis 24,90 HKD am unteren Ende der Spanne; erster Schlusskurs laut Caproasia 24,02 HKD, ein Minus von 3,5 %.
note.bg: Цена при предлагането 24,90 HKD в долния край на диапазона; първа цена при затваряне 24,02 HKD според Caproasia, или спад с 3,5%.
note.en: Priced at HKD 24.90, the bottom of the range; first close at HKD 24.02 according to Caproasia, down 3.5%.
note.es: Precio de salida de 24,90 HKD, en el extremo inferior del rango; primer cierre a 24,02 HKD según Caproasia, un 3,5 % menos.
note.tr: Halka arz fiyatı aralığın alt ucunda 24,90 HKD; Caproasia'ya göre ilk kapanış 24,02 HKD, %3,5 düşüş.
